Interface UserInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
CLIinterface, GameViewController, LobbyController
public interface UserInterface
Contract implemented by every client-side view (CLI and GUI). The DTO visitors invoke these callbacks as lobby and game messages arrive, so the concrete view can render the corresponding state without knowing the transport details.
